about: Help-First beacon driver PCB, spin 1. Source of truth for build.py. Coordinates in mm from the board's top-left corner (x right, y down, parts side), rotation in degrees CCW as KiCad shows it. Designed 2026-11-27 (see DESIGN.md); pin plan per decision #46, high-side shaker #47, silence button #48.

components.assembly: JLCPCB THT (wave/hand) or founder hand-solder; option A vs B
components.why: Battery socket, side entry, opening on the right edge. Pad 1 = pack + (JST circuit No. 1, where Adafruit packs put the red wire), pad 2 = GND. Corrected 2026-11-27: Adafruit's/SparkFun's Eagle libraries number these two pins mirror-image to JST and KiCad. Anchor = pad 1 (GND); pad 2 VBAT_IN at (63.7, 43.6). Rotation 90 puts the mating face on the right edge (body x 62.35-69.95). Lowest connector on the right edge, nearest the battery cradle's open right end; down is blocked (pack top 4.8 mm below the board)

keepouts: Back side, ledge strips: the board rests on 1.5 mm ledges along both long edges, 3 mm above the back plate. No through-hole pad copper, lead tail or solder joint within 2.5 mm of y=0 or y=50 (i.e. keep THT pads inside y 2.5-47.5). Trim every lead tail to 2.0 mm or less (J1, J3, J4, J5, U1, U2 headers, J2/J6 wires). Nothing on the back except copper, mask and silkscreen.

Siren-holder height zone: x 5.5-57.0, y 0-17.0 (the holder shelf sits 16.4 mm in front of the board, about 15.4 mm with 1 mm foam tape): parts 13 mm or lower, and no harness connectors (J4, J5) in this zone. Everywhere else: 15 mm including mated plugs and wire bends.

Right edge is the only cable edge: J3 (y 8.9-34.3), J2 (y 36.1-39.3), J1 (y 41.2-48.1). Nothing may protrude past x=70 for y < 9: the LoRa SMA body starts 1.2 mm right of the top-right corner (case z 114 and up). Free space to the right is 14 mm (to the LoRa module) for y < 47, open below that.
No connectors on the left edge (4.3 mm to the wall), top edge (9.7 mm to the wall, siren holder and SMA) or bottom edge (battery pack top 4.8 mm below, cradle wall 2.7 mm below for x < 56).
Rule area 'no footprints' (tracks and pours allowed, vias tented) under U1's Pololu board: x 18.77-33.97, y 34.73-49.93.
Rule area 'no footprints' under U2's Adafruit board: x 36.53-54.31, y 17.46-36.51; inside it, no vias and no exposed copper under the speaker-terminal pins: x 41.5-49.5, y 31.0-35.0.
Copper to board edge at least 0.5 mm. No vias inside the Q11 or Q16 pads (thermal vias at least 0.3 mm outside the pad, tented).

Bottom layer: keep the battery-return area x 20-70, y 36-50 free of bottom-layer traces (solid GND under the J1 -> Q11 -> U1 path), and keep the plane unbroken under the I2S traces (x 46-60, y 15-21).
SGND copper only between J3 pins 1/8/14 and R20 pin 1; it must not touch the GND pours.

Silkscreen (front, at least 1.0 mm text): 'BATTERY ONLY + -' at J1; 'LILYGO BATT + -' at J2; 'BUTTONS - NOT BATTERY' and pin names at J5; '12V OUT' and pin names at J4; 'SHAKER TIP / SLEEVE - bed shaker only' at J6; J3 pin 1 plus the LilyGO hole for each pin; U1 outline with OUT and EN; U2 outline with Vin and LRC; every test-point name.
trace_widths: Battery path VBAT_IN and VBAT_SH (J1 pin 2 -> R1 -> Q11 drain): top-layer copper pours, at least 3.0 mm wide (IPC-2221 external, 1 oz, 10 C rise, my calculation: about 1.4 mm for 3 A, 2.8 mm for 5 A peaks).
VBAT_PROT main bus (Q11 source -> U1 VIN pads 4/5, C1, C2): pour or track at least 2.5 mm; 2.0 mm minimum in necks.
VBAT_PROT branches: to J2 pad 1 at least 1.5 mm (2 A bursts both ways); to U2 Vin, C3, C4 and R15 at least 1.0 mm.

GND: bottom layer solid plane. J1 pin 1, U1 pads 2/3, C1-, C2-, TVS1 anode, D1 anode and J6 pin 2 reach it through at least 4-6 vias each (0.3 mm drill / 0.6 mm pad). Through-hole GND pads use thermal reliefs (4 spokes, at least 0.5 mm; at least 0.75 mm on U1 GND); SMD pads connect solid.
+12V (U1 OUT -> C5, F2 pin 1, Q16 source, R11): at least 1.0 mm. +12V_INT (F2 pin 2 -> C7, D2, J4 pins 1/3/5): at least 0.6 mm.

SIREN_SW, LIGHT_SW, REDLED_SW (MOSFET drain -> J4): at least 0.5 mm. SHK_OUT and SHK_JACK (Q16 -> F1 -> J6, TVS1, D1): at least 0.6 mm; TVS1 anode to the plane 5 mm or shorter and at least 1.0 mm wide.
SGND (J3 pins 1, 8, 14 -> R20 pin 1): at least 1.0 mm (the three ribbon grounds can carry up to about 1.5 A of LilyGO current together, estimate).
R1 Kelvin sense traces to TP1/TP2: 0.25 mm from the inner edges of R1's pads.

All signals (gates, I2S, buttons, LED, silence, BOOST_EN, AMP_SD, AMP_GAIN, SHK_PG, SHK_DRV): 0.25 mm. Clearance 0.2 mm everywhere. I2S traces 40 mm or shorter over unbroken GND, away from U1 and the U2 speaker terminal.

Design rules for JLCPCB (conservative): min track 0.2 mm, min clearance 0.2 mm, vias 0.3 mm drill / 0.6 mm pad (no surcharge), copper-to-edge 0.5 mm, hole-to-hole 0.25 mm, annular ring 0.25 mm on plated holes, text height 1.0 mm or more. Keep each library footprint's own drill sizes (PH 0.75 mm, XH 0.95 mm, IDC and pin headers 1.0 mm, wire pads 1.15 and 0.85 mm).
